Use paper circles and a lamp-free diagram to show day and night. Use a labeled drawing and 3-5 sentences.

practice.title: Art
practice.passage: Framing selects part of a scene; photographs can be accurate but incomplete. Ask permission before photographing people or private spaces.

items.prompt: Does a photo show everything about an event?
Frame the same harmless object two ways, or draw the two views; identify omissions. Use a labeled drawing and 3-5 sentences.

practice.title: Life Sciences
practice.passage: Hindu traditions developed over a long history in South Asia and include many texts, philosophies, and practices. Dharma and karma are important in many traditions, but there is no single uniform Hindu practice.

items.prompt: Why avoid saying all Hindus practice identically?
Locate South Asia and revise an overgeneralization to acknowledge diversity. Use a labeled drawing and 3-5 sentences.

items.prompt: In a random sample, 15 of 60 students choose art. Estimate how many of 400 students choose art.

Design a representative sample to ask 300 students about lunch choices.

contexts: W1 data: A fictional class compares water collection in two labeled trials using the same time interval. Trial A: 11 milliliters of water collected; Trial B: 19 milliliters of water collected. These are invented assessment data, not a claim about a real investigation.

items.prompt: Use W1 data. Which trial has the higher recorded value, and by how much?
Use W1 data. State one observation without claiming its cause.
